'''Christophsian sugar''' was a type of [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> that shared its name with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restuarant]] located on<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] offered the sugar as a free additive to the [[Caf/Legends|caf]] and [[stim tea]] beverages it sold. The diner also sold [[Iktotch toast]] dusted with powdered Christophsian sugar for 4.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] and [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]]&ndash;style [[Doughnut/Legends|donuts]] with powdered Christophsian sugar for 1.5 credits each.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Christophsian sugar was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
